domain.extension: ymin_new = ymin_old - 128h; original rows embedded at [128:384]; filler rows = background

params.note: eta/rho = 2 is the ideal sustained-activation total relaxation strength (magnitude estimate only)

geometry.chi_e_rule: ideal disk intersected with Omega1; truncation audit counts ideal-positive cells outside the rectangle; ANY positive-support truncation => GEOMETRY_INVALID (no auto fix)

target.recipe: U*,V* = ub,vb + chi_E * roll(D_shift7 dev, rows -136, cols +86) applied to BOTH u and v (each component receives BOTH periodic shifts); exact background outside chi_E>0; constructed once at t0; no later script injection/reset
target.correction: EGS-T004: historical egs_common.build_geometry rolled u by cols only and v by rows only (one axis missing per component; EGS-T003 Agent1 review). Corrected implementation + independent element-wise direct-index recomputation in experiment/egs/egs_t004_target.py; bit-equality required

measurement.core_note: local detector replicating project caliber (u > ub + 0.100, 4-connected, >=5 px, own-mask weighted centroid); independent EGS code

records.event_rule: save adjacent full four-field snapshots on first a>theta (D), first a>a* with chi_E>0 (emission/g>0), and first core overlapping the output window

run.note: EGS-T004: corrected implementation runs a LIMITED WAIT control to 60000 first (misfire check: D activation / g>0 / established output => record and STOP), then QUERY from the registered initial t=0 to 120000 with full records and resumable checkpoints; the historical T001 WAIT (g==0 throughout) supports but does NOT substitute for these new-implementation records

standby_rules.trigger_indicator: first sample with g_max > 0 (emission active: a > a_star on chi_E > 0)
standby_rules.output_indicator: first sample with any detected core overlapping the output window
standby_rules.judgment: ANY trigger or output indicator => standby FAILED with actual time and saved field; if neither occurs, only claim 'not seen within this finite window' (local0-120000)
standby_rules.lineage_note: cores overlapping the output window are identity-matched to the initial sources so drifted pre-existing cores are transparent

fail_rules.action: save state and STOP (no clipping, no rescue)

core_acceptance.source: same frozen rule as the standard pipeline

notes: both branches share the S06 history (not a uniform background)
the relaxation term uses the OLD g with the OLD u,v (synchronous Euler); the frozen core produces the GS base, then the g increment is added
no external time-varying control; target fixed at t0
prechecks cover numerical-stability necessities only -- not consistency or dynamics validation
